pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī saṅghena samanubhaṭṭhā bhikkhuniyo evaṃ vadeti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.3: saṃsaṭṭhāva ayye tumhe viharatha mā tumhe nānā viharittha
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.4: santi saṅghe aññāpi bhikkhuniyo evācārā evaṃsaddā evaṃsilokā bhikkhunisaṅghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā tā saṅgho na kiñci āha.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.5: tumhaññeva saṅgho uññāya paribhavena akkhantiyā vebhassā dubbalyā evamāha. bhaginiyo kho saṃsaṭṭhā viharanti pāpācārā pāpasaddā pāpasilokā bhikkhunisaṅghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā viviccathayye. vivekaññeva bhaginīnaṃ saṅgho vaṇṇetīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā saṅghena samanubhaṭṭhā bhikkhuniyo evaṃ vakkhati
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.8: “saṃsaṭṭhāva ayye tumhe viharatha, mā tumhe nānā viharittha
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.9: santi saṅghe aññāpi bhikkhuniyo evācārā evaṃsaddā …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.10: viviccathayye vivekaññeva bhaginīnaṃ saṅgho vaṇṇetī”ti. atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ bhikkhu ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti: “kathaṃ hi nāma thullanandā bhikkhunī saṅghena samanubhaṭṭhā bhikkhuniyo evaṃ vakkhati saṃsaṭṭhāva ayye tumhe viharatha mā tumhe nānā viharittha santi saṅghe aññāpi bhikkhuniyo evācārā evaṃsaddā …pe… viviccathayye vivekaññeva bhaginīnaṃ saṅgho vaṇṇetī”ti. atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.11: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhuṇī saṅghena samanubhaṭṭhā bhikkhuniyo evaṃ vadeti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.12: “saṃsaṭṭhāva ayye tumhe viharatha mā tumhe nānā viharittha
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.13: satti saṅghe aññāpi bhikkhuniyo evācārā evaṃsaddā …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.17: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī saṅghena samanubhaṭṭhā bhikkhuniyo evaṃ vakkhati
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.18: saṃsaṭṭhāva ayye tumhe viharatha mā tumhe nānā viharittha
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.19: santi saṅghe aññāpi bhikkhuniyo evācārā evaṃsaddā …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.22: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.24: “saṃsaṭṭhāva ayye tumhe viharatha mā tumhe nānā viharittha
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.25: santi saṅghe aññāpi bhikkhuniyo evācārā evaṃsaddā evaṃsilokā bhikkhunisaṅghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjappaṭicchādikā tā saṅgho na kiñci āha.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.26: tumhaññeva saṅgho uññāya paribhavena akkhantiyā vebhassā dubbalyā evamāha: bhaginiyo kho saṃsaṭṭhā viharanti pāpācārā pāpasaddā pāpasilokā bhikkhunisaṅghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā, viviccathayye. vivekaññeva bhaginīnaṃ saṅgho vaṇṇetī”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.29: saṃsaṭṭhāva ayye tumhe viharatha, mā tumhe nānā viharittha,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.30: santi saṅghe aññāpi bhikkhuniyo evācārā evaṃsaddā evaṃsilokā bhikkhunisaṅghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā tā saṅgho na kiñci āha,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.31: tumhaññeva saṅgho uññāya paribhavena akkhantiyā vebhassā dubbalyā evamāha. bhaginiyo kho saṃsaṭṭhā viharanti pāpācārā pāpasaddā pāpasilokā bhikkhunisaṅghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā, viviccathayye. vivekaññeva bhaginīnaṃ saṅgho vaṇṇetī”ti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.32: evañca sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi vuccamānā tatheva paggaṇheyya, sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.33: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyya iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.34: no ce paṭinissajjeyya ayampi bhikkhunī yāvatatiyakaṃ dhammaṃ āpannā nissāraṇīyaṃ saṅghādisesa’nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.6: saṃsaṭṭhāva ayye tumhe viharatha mā tumhe nānā viharittha
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.7: santi saṅghe aññāpi bhikkhuniyo evācārā evaṃsaddā evaṃsilokā, bhikkhunisaṅghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjappaṭicchādikā, tā saṅgho na kiñci āha
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.19: bhaginiyo kho saṃsaṭṭhā viharanti pāpācārā pāpasaddā pāpasilokā bhikkhunisaṅghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.24: aññāhi bhikkhunīhi, yā passanti yā suṇanti tāhi vattabbā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.26: saṃsaṭṭhāva ayye tumhe viharatha. mā tumhe nānā viharittha
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.36: saṃsaṭṭhāva ayye tumhe viharatha mā tumhe nānā viharittha
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.47: ayaṃ itthannāmā bhikkhunī saṅghena samanubhaṭṭhā bhikkhuniyo evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.50: santi saṅghe aññāpi bhikkhuniyo evācārā evaṃsaddā evaṃsilokā bhikkhunisaṅghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.52: tumhaññeva saṅgho uññāya paribhavena akkhantiyā vebhassā dubbalyā evamāha:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.53: “bhaginiyo kho saṃsaṭṭhā viharanti pāpācārā pāpasaddā pāpasilokā bhikkhunisaṅghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.57: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.60: ayaṃ itthannāmā bhikkhunī saṅghena samanubhaṭṭhā bhikkhuniyo evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.63: santi saṅghe aññāpi bhikkhuniyo evācārā evaṃsaddā evaṃsilokā bhikkhunisaṅghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.65: tumhaññeva saṅgho uññāya paribhavena akkhantiyā vebhassā dubbalyā evamāha:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.66: “bhaginiyo kho saṃsaṭṭhā viharanti pāpācārā pāpasaddā pāpasilokā, bhikkhunisaṅghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.70: saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ samanubhāsati tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.71: yassā ayyāya khamati itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā samanubhāsanā tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya, sā tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.75: samanubhaṭṭhā saṅghena itthannāmā bhikkhunī tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.76: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.80: saṅghādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjantiyā ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ dvīhi kammavācāhi thullaccayā paṭippassambhanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.88: saṅghova tassā āpattiyā mānattaṃ deti mūlāya paṭikassati abbheti na sambahulā na ekā bhikkhunī, tena vuccati saṅghādisesoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.89: tassa ceva āpattinikāyassa nāmakammaṃ adhivacanaṃ tenapi vuccati saṅghādisesoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:3.16: yesaṃ bhikkhunī aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjati tāya bhikkhuniyā ubhato saṅghe pakkhamānattaṃ caritabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:3.17: ciṇṇamānattā bhikkhunī yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhunisaṅgho tattha sā bhikkhunī abbhetabbā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:3.18: ekāyapi ce ūno. vīsatigaṇo bhikkhunisaṅgho taṃ bhikkhuniṃ abbheyya
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:3.19: sā ca bhikkhunī anabbhitā tā ca bhikkhuniyo gārayhā ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:3.27: tesaṃ uddānaṃ: ussayaṃ corī gāmantaṃ ukkhittaṃ khādanena ca kineta kupitā kismiñci saṃsaṭṭhuññāya te dasāti. sattarasakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
